title: NFC Not Working for Libre 1
body:
### Subject of the issue
I'm using Libre 1 with miaomiao 1. While my miaomiao 1 is charging, I need to scan my libre 1 with NFC, but every time I try this, I get a toast saying "Scanned OK!", but no data is added to the graph. If I attach my miaomiao 1 again, it reads through bluetooth with no issues. I've searched for this issue here, but no luck so far.

Please let me know if you need any more info on how to reproduce the issue.

### Your environment
- Xdrip Version: cc96742-2021.06.19
- Xdrip Code 2106191119
- Device: Galaxy S7 Edge
- Device Model: SM-G935F
- Android Version: 8.0.0
- Libre Version: 1
- Miaomiao Version: 1

### Expected behavior
I expected the NFC scan to add data to graph just as it does with bluetooth.

### Actual behavior
It says the scan happened, but no data is added to graph.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Connect a libre 1 sensor with miaomiao 1
2. Calibrate
3. Take a few readings
4. Remove miaomiao 1
5. Try scanning libre 1 with NFC

comments.body: Updated to the latest version and seems fixed there, sorry for not checking it first.
